purpose: Deterministic composition contract for assignee (coder) task-assignment prompts: the audience-scoped section set, the validation rules that fail composition closed, and the measured section budgets. The composed prompt is an execution interface; machine provenance, routing diagnostics, and lifecycle bookkeeping live in the bound trace receipt, never in the prompt body.

section_budgets.measurement_basis: Seeded from the measured approved reference fixtures in tests/fixtures/assignment_prompts/ (UTF-8 bytes per composed section, including the heading line), with headroom for legitimately larger real projects: prose sections carry roughly 2-6x the measured fixture size, the implementation contract allows a full software-profile specification, active guidance allows the largest execution capsule plus an active judgment hold, and curated deliverable inputs allow the 64KiB resource bound. tests/cli/commands/test_compose_assignment_prompt.py re-measures the fixtures against these budgets so the numbers cannot silently drift below the fixtures that justify them.

forbidden_in: assignee-facing instruction prose (any composed prompt section)
task instruction sections (goal, notes, evidence gate, acceptance)
blanket_governance_reads.permitted_as: a source identity or provenance value: a provenance row carrying one of the declared row prefixes inside a declared provenance section
blanket_governance_reads.recovery: inline the bounded applicable excerpt instead of directing a whole-document read

validation_findings.meaning: A machine JSON payload (classifier/selector result, receipt, or fenced json block) appears in an assignee-facing section.
The authoritative source-guidance record is rendered more than once.
An acceptance criterion or specification contract block is repeated verbatim.
Review-audience material appears in a coder prompt.
A PM-only lifecycle command or instruction appears in an assignee-facing section.
An unredacted project-management identifier appears in the prompt body.

Instruction content directs the assignee to read a whole governance document instead of carrying the bounded applicable excerpt; a source identity or provenance row inside Source guidance is not an instruction and is permitted.
The prompt claims a source is current although the governing record does not establish currency.
A required assignee-facing section is absent or empty.
The outcome section carries no checkable done criteria.
The governing specification still carries open questions; the implementation contract is not settled.
A section exceeds its measured budget without an explicit recorded reason.

source_currency_note: An 'Applicable context' value is a historical fact about the source (the edition, date, or version the guidance was authored against). It does not by itself require or forbid currently installed behavior. 'Status: current' is a verified claim established by the governing record's validation, not an assumption; when the task requires current behavior and the record does not establish compatibility, composition fails instead of restating the stale claim.
